description: The Congo Hold-up investigation: the corruption network around the Sicomines contract
verification_status: the scheme's structure is confirmed by primary sources (The Sentry, PPLAAF); specific dollar amounts for individual branches vary between reports - ranges are given

investigation.name: Congo Hold-up
leak_organizers: PPLAAF (Platform to Protect Whistleblowers in Africa)
investigation.data_volume: 3.5 million leaked BGFIBank documents (bank statements, letters, contracts, invoices)
investigation.participants: 19 media organizations + 5 NGOs (including The Sentry, Al Jazeera, BBC, Der Spiegel, RFI, Le Soir, NRC Handelsblad), about 100 people across 18 countries
investigation.bank_source: BGFIBank Group (headquartered in Gabon, with a Congolese subsidiary)

nodes_in_the_scheme.role: principal shareholders of Sicomines (68%), source of the covert financing
nodes_in_the_scheme.amount_musd: not stated directly - funds were routed through CCC

nodes_in_the_scheme.role: shell company with no real construction activity; a financial conduit
nodes_in_the_scheme.amount_musd: 55-65 (sources diverge: the user's original document says $55m of 'proven Chinese origin'; The Sentry's 'The Backchannel' report says Du Wei moved $65m through CCC's accounts)
nodes_in_the_scheme.detail: in July 2018, a single $2.5m cash withdrawal despite a ban; in 2016, transfers in $25m quarterly tranches ahead of the expiry of Kabila's mandate

nodes_in_the_scheme.role: the central node; run by President Kabila's brother
nodes_in_the_scheme.manager: Selemani Francis Mtwale (Joseph Kabila's adoptive brother), managing director 2011-2018
nodes_in_the_scheme.shareholder: Gloria Mteyu (Kabila's sister) - 40% when the bank was founded in 2010
nodes_in_the_scheme.amount_musd: 138 (per PPLAAF/Mediapart - the minimum in DRC state funds that passed through the bank to Kabila's circle); L'Orient Today cites the same $138m figure plus separately $33m deposited in cash and $72m from unknown sources channeled through a Central Bank account

nodes_in_the_scheme.role: sources of state funds redirected through BGFIBank
nodes_in_the_scheme.amount_musd: 94.5 (Central Bank, per the user's original document) + 20 (Gecamines) - these specific figures were not independently re-verified in this round
~31 (per the user's original document - transferred by CCC directly to Kabila-linked individuals/companies); not independently re-verified

international_banks.allegation: The Sentry accuses these banks of failing to exercise due diligence while dealing with BGFIBank

aftermath.political: Tshisekedi launched a purge of Kabila loyalists in the state apparatus after taking power
aftermath.judicial: reports indicate legal proceedings began against implicated figures under the Tshisekedi administration
aftermath.structural: opacity in the mining sector persists; informal networks realigned around new political elites

sources: The Sentry - 'The Backchannel: State Capture and Bribery in Congo's Deal of the Century' (2021-11-29/30)
